ideas.title: Minnesota Child Care Program Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota agency's investigation into over 150 providers receiving funding from the state child care program.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to uncover potential fraud and abuse in the program.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a large-scale fraud scheme in the child care program.

ideas.title: FBI Revenue Diversion Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's investigation into allegations of revenue diversion in Florence.
ideas.angle: Uncover the details of the alleged revenue diversion and who is responsible.
questions: What is the extent of the revenue diversion?
Who is responsible for the revenue diversion?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant financial crime.
